nodes.author: RachesElla
nodes.text: ❄️As for the respiratory disease surge in China, while it's concerning, I believe it’s manageable. This kind of seasonal spike in respiratory illnesses—be it HMPV, RSV, flu, or adenovirus—occurs regularly during the winter months

nodes.author: RachesElla
nodes.text: 🌍It’s essential not to jump to conclusions based on early or incomplete data. Let’s focus on a fact-based approach and remember that the increased incidence of respiratory diseases in the colder months is something we’ve seen before.
